user.description:
Tailcat gives the devices you pair access to Home Assistant from anywhere through an encrypted tunnel, without port forwarding or an account. Only paired devices can connect.

Do you want to set it up?

abort.key_generation_failed: Generating a key for the device failed. Check the logs for details.
abort.not_loaded: Tailcat is not running. Make sure it is set up correctly before pairing a device.
abort.server_not_running: The Tailcat server is not running. Check the logs for details and try again.

pair.description:
Scan this code with the Home Assistant app on {name}, then select **Submit** to allow the device. It connects a few seconds after you submit. Other paired devices briefly reconnect, as the tunnel restarts once. Closing this dialog without submitting cancels the pairing.

If you cannot scan the code, open this link on the device. Keep it secret, it grants access to Home Assistant:

`{pairing_url}`
pair.title: Scan the pairing code

data_description.name: A name to recognize the device by, for example the name of your phone.
